quote: the following nonprescription or herbal products may interact with alendronate: aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen), mineral oils, calcium supplements, or antacids (e.g. - calcium carbonate, milk of magnesia, famotidine, ranitidine, omperazole, esomeprazole, lansoprazole). if you are taking any other medications including supplements, vitamins, or antacids by mouth, take them at least 30 minutes after you take alendronate.
